verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's privacy docs say it provides deletion APIs to help implementations meet GDPR requirements, so the deletion half of the story is covered by a first-party capability, though only through a single brief mention. Nothing in the pack shows Mixpanel offering its own retention-period controls; the warehouse retention settings belong to Snowflake and Databricks, not Mixpanel. Missing for 10: documented data-retention period controls, detail on the deletion API's scope and workflow, AI/MCP-driven deletion or retention management, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Mixpanel deletion and retrieval APIs are in place to help Mixpanel implementations meet the requirements outlined by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) legislation.
